research_notes: Dublin-based commercial barristers specialising in Irish company and corporate law. Solo/small practice led by Mahmud Samad BL. Site is static HTML with no CMS, no meta tags, minimal social presence. 57 pages of detailed legal content. Serves both domestic and international clients.
pitch_notes: **Pros:** Strong technical need (dated static site, no CMS, 57 pages to migrate), right size for freelancer, Dublin-based and accessible, serves international audience who would judge on web presence. **Cons:** No active buying signal, barristers often rely on referrals not websites, fixed-fee model suggests cost-consciousness.
